visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use ctype Instead of Magic Numbers
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The code compares against the numbers 97, 122, 65, 90 and 32. Rewrite it with isalpha, toupper and tolower from ctype.h. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Character literals like 'a' and library helpers name what they mean, while 97 and 32 are magic numbers nobody can read at a glance.
